The witch {npc:Wyda}, in the Green Claw Swamp near Venore, talks about the usefulness of a rare herb that grows next to dead trees. Cross the Venore Rotworm Cave and the swamp, kill a {creature:Giant Spider} and open the {item:Dead Tree} to get a {item:Blood Herb}, which you can keep as a valuable decoration or swap with Wyda for a {item:Witchesbroom}.
The witch Wyda talks about what this herb is useful for. It grows near dead trees; maybe you should try the dead tree not far from her house.
or equivalent, for the Jungle Grass
or equivalent, for the Loose Stone Piles
Recommended: {item:Antidote Rune|Antidote Runes} or the {spell:Cure Poison} spell.
or trade it with Wyda for the Witchesbroom
optional, in exchange for the Blood Herb
There are several weaker poisonous creatures along the way: bring antidotes.
Many players prefer to keep the {item:Blood Herb}, because it's a very valuable decoration, instead of trading it for the Witchesbroom.

If you're not in **Venore**, take a boat (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}). Leave **Venore** by the **southwest** exit and follow the road **northwest**. About 3/4 of the way to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, turn off **north** and look for the hole to the Venore Rotworm Cave ({wiki:Green Claw Swamp}). Open the {item:Loose Stone Pile} with the {item:Shovel} and go in.
The entrance to the Venore Rotworm Cave
Go down one more floor and head **north**. Climb up with the {item:Rope} at the next rope spot and follow the path to the **northeast** end of the cave.
Cave map: yellow = start, green = rope spot

At the end of the cave there are 3 paths: the ramps to the **north** lead to the {wiki:Bewitched} cauldron, the hole to the **east** leads to the {wiki:Silver Brooch Quest}. For this quest **climb the ladder**.
Cave map: yellow = start, green = ladder up
The ladder that leads to Wyda's area
You climb to the surface, where there's a {creature:Wasp} and a coffin. In the coffin is the {item:Key 5000}, which opens {npc:Wyda}'s house, but you don't need it.
Climb another ladder to {npc:Wyda}'s house. Walk along the planks around the house to the end.
The witches on the hill east of the house
Map: red = witches' hill, yellow = ladder down
2 {creature:Witch|Witches} spawn on a hill to the **east** and can attack you from range while you walk.
Go down and cut the grass
Go down the ladder and cut the {item:Jungle Grass} to the **south** with the {item:Machete}.
Enter through the Loose Stone Pile
Head **south**, beneath the witches' hill, and then **east** to a {item:Loose Stone Pile}. Use the {item:Shovel} and go in.
The Loose Stone Pile where you use the shovel

Follow the passage **east**. The path splits in two: the **east** ramp (going down) leads to a part of the {wiki:The Inquisition Quest}, where {creature:The Count} spawns. For the Blood Herb, go up the **west** ramp.
The west ramp that leads to the Dead Tree
Get ready and go up: there is a single {creature:Giant Spider}. Kill it.
The Giant Spider poisons and hits hard for low levels. Bring potions and antidotes.
Open the {item:Dead Tree} on the **north** side of the small patch of ground to receive the {item:Blood Herb}.
The Dead Tree with the Blood Herb
Decide what to do with the herb
Go back the same way to {npc:Wyda} and decide whether you want to trade the {item:Blood Herb} for her {item:Witchesbroom}. The choice is yours.
You can also keep the Blood Herb for when Wyda is bored ({wiki:Bored Mini World Change}), so you have a chance to receive a {item:Torn Teddy}.

From {npc:Wyda}'s house, climb down the ladders to the coffin's surface and then down to the Venore Rotworm Cave. Do the route from section 1 in reverse: go **southwest**, go down where you came up with the {item:Rope}, head back **south**, go up the floor you came down and leave through the entrance hole (use the {item:Rope}). Then follow the road **southeast** to the southwest exit of Venore.
